title: Mickey Factz - #StoreRunner (TRU FOE DISS)

Directed by Mr Good Evening

Mickey Factz ends the trilogy with a scathing diss entitled #STORERUNNER 
The story goes Aye Noun paid Tru Foe to diss Mickey Factz and Mickey proceeded to write 3 songs in under 20 hours from 2 am to 7 pm. Mind you he slept from 7 am to 11 am. So its really 16 hours. Anyway, Factz being the mc he is channeled his anger into one of the most catchiest and creative diss records to date. Long Live Lyricism.

ਪਤਾ ਲੱਗੂ ਸਾਡੇ ਲਈ ਜੋ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਫ਼ਤਾਬ ਨੇ !
When one learns to enjoy every moment, only then ; They learn to avoid the small sorrows !

ਹਾਲੇ ਚਾਬੀਆਂ ਗੁਆਉਣੀਆਂ ਤੇ ਤਾ’ਲੇ ਚਮਕਾਉਣੇ !

ਏਹੋ ਸਾਰੇ ਹੀ ਤਮਾਸ਼ੇ ਬੜੇ ਲਾ-ਜਵਾਬ ਨੇ !
Life still has many lessons left to teach;
Keys are yet to be lost & locks yet to be more teasing for that !
Entries must again be made through the back doors !
All these spectacles are remarkably wondrous !

ਐਸੇ ਆਲਮ ਵੀ ਅੱਗੇ ਬੜੇ ਬੇ-ਹਿਸਾਬ ਨੇ !
Whatever is to come will come as a surprise !
If it comes late, it will bring a little anxiety !
There will be fierce battles with destiny !
Such phases too are countless in coming life !

This, indeed, is true virtue to offer consolation !!

title: "Donald's Sewage Stream" - Marsh Family adapt "Islands in the Stream" by Dolly Parton & Kenny Rogers
description:
“Islands in the Stream” was written by the Bee Gees, named after an Ernest Hemingway novel, and first intended for Diana Ross … but it found its most famous home in the epic country rendition released by Kenny Rogers and Dolly Parton in 1983 which was Dolly’s second number one hit – knocking Bonnie Tyler’s “Total Eclipse of the Heart” off the top spot! 

We had planned to do a cover of it to mark Dolly’s 80th birthday earlier this week. But with the bizarre episodes engineered by Donald Trump and some of his despicable false claims about NATO and track records dominating headlines this week, we determined to create a parody reflecting on his increasingly rambling, drivelling, narcissistic, and palpably untrue speeches – including notably the one he gave at Davos as he climbed down (for now) from his bullying of Greenland (not Iceland, as in the clip). 

For the facts Trump got wrong and the sources used:
- ABC News: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hDgfOdEJyZE
- Trump Davos speech: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qo2-q4AFh_g
- Fact checks of it: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c301jgd1qj6o, https://edition.cnn.com/2026/01/21/politics/trump-davos-nato-greenland-fact-check

*Update 12 hours after upload: thanks for helpful people adding to our fact checking, and reminding that although Trump “taunted men who served as soldiers” there were also many female service people and sadly casualties in the Afghanistan operation.

How come when he gets up every speech drones on?
He sets out to lecture with his facts all wrong 
He’s gone soft inside 
There is nothing going on!

Someone’s autocue-ing but he’s unrestrained  
They must wonder “Can’t he read the pane?”
Every speech falls apart
Ego-spewing marathons

Audiences try
Kind of hide their trepidation
Knowing Trump’s show’in real deterioration
They smile as he blathers: “uh-huh!”
Making up all his numbers, “uh-huh!”

Donald’s sewage stream
Verbal salad bar
Someone intervene!
You can see he’s wrong
Ailing mentally
In his made-up world
Where he just lies for an hour, uh-huh!
From one subject to another, uh-huh!

Whistle’s going choo-choo yet the train’s done gone
Gibbering and waffling but the lights ain’t on
So he just talks all this shite
Slowly losing sight of the real things

Now it can happen often that he slurs and shouts
Doing impressions as he gurns and pouts 
And the message is clear:
This must be the year for dementing

No more alibis
He’s not wily, quirky, clever … 
His grasp of world events
Is just a toddler’s
He can’t hide it forever – nuh-huh
Bigging up his dystopia, nuh-huh

Donald’s sewage stream
That has gone too far
Veterans now demeaned
Getting history wrong
Making mockery
In his latest slur
Of how we fought with each other, huh-uh
Taunting men who served as soldiers, huh-uh

So debased
Oh defames their memory

Wizened tangerine
Bogus and bizarre
Always venting spleen
Like King *senile* Kong
Fade away now please
From our media
So we can talk to each other, uh-huh
Without felons taking over, uh-huh

title: JAMESY - NACHANA ft VZN & Hennie Baker (Prod @YogeshBeats)
description:
“Nachana” is a high-energy Nepali track inspired by the infectious grooves of Brazilian funk, blended with our own desi flavor. 💃🏽🕺🏽
This song is all about movement, confidence, and letting the rhythm take over—when the beat drops, timi NACHANA.

From heavy bass to catchy hooks, “Nachana” brings global sounds together with a Nepali soul. Turn up the volume, feel the groove, and dance like nobody’s watching.

🎧 Listen. Feel. Nacha

title: LADY GAGA - ABRACADABRA (LIVE AT THE 2026 GRAMMYS)

Performing with her MAYHEM co-producers ANDREW WATT and CIRKUT, alongside JOSH FREESE.
LADY GAGA, MICHAEL POLANSKY, ANDREW WATT, CIRKUT (Producer of the Year), PARRIS GOEBEL, BEN DALGLEISH, HARDSTYLE, FREDERIC ASPIRAS & SARAH TANNO. Thank you to ALEXANDER MCQUEEN for the humble honor of sharing with us this piece of fashion history.

"House of Cards" lyrics
Sister, I never saw you get your flowers; living out in the cold and you were hanging by a thread. For all these years, the blood, the sweat, the dread. The tears and voices in my head; they paint a picture of a disaster inside me. We can always see into the stars, but we can’t see the hurt inside our hearts. Everything that glitters isn’t gold – I’m sick of always sleeping in the freezing cold. Brother, your heart was torn out by our mother. Dear lord, he’s sick of living between the sword and the wall. For all these years, the blood, the sweat, the dread. The tears and voices in my head; they paint a picture of a disaster inside me. Hate is easy, hate is easy, hate is easy… You’ve gotta try and love yourself. We can always see into the stars, but we can’t see the hurt inside our hearts. Everything that glitters isn’t gold – I’m sick of always sleeping in… Woah oh, hate is easy love yourself. You better try and love yourself.

[Letra de "Tu Amor Me Hace Bien"]

[Intro]
¡Opa!

Porque me gusta tenerte, vida mía
Y no quiero que te vayas

Nos aturde los sentidos

Ay, tu amor me controla

Ay, tu amor me controla

Mira que me hace bien, ay, que me hace bien

[Verso 2]
Te quiero así, tan precisa, equivocada
Con tus detalles que matan
Porque tenerte a mi lado me hace fuerte
Si eres mi reina y mi espada
Te quiero así, cuando ríes, cuando callas
Porque al caer, me levantas
Porque mi voz y mi espíritu se agitan

description:
Tema: Deportado Carnaval
Autor (Letra y Música): Ángel Guaraca
Arreglos Musicales: Ángel Guaraca
Producción General: Producciones Guaraca Internacional S.A.

© Canción de propiedad del Indio Cantor de América, Ángel Guaraca.
Queda prohibida cualquier modificación, alteración o uso sin la debida autorización del propietario.
El uso no autorizado tendrá consecuencias legales. Evítese problemas.

Tres mensajes importantes quedan plasmados en esta canción carnavalera:

1️⃣ A pesar de toda adversidad, cada año no puede faltar esta hermosa fiesta del Carnaval, donde el pueblo se reúne para gozar, reír y disfrutar, porque la alegría también es resistencia.

2️⃣ Un mensaje de incentivo y voto de ánimo para todos nuestros hermanos migrantes que partieron hacia los Estados Unidos y que, por estar indocumentados, tuvieron que regresar. No todo está perdido: hoy están junto a lo más valioso que existe, la familia, y eso no tiene precio.

3️⃣ Un mensaje de admiración a la dama sencilla y hermosa, con un pedido sincero: que jamás cambie, que sea siempre natural, porque la mujer, mientras más natural es, más bella se vuelve.

Con cariño, esta inspiración del
Indio Cantor de América
ÁNGEL GUARACA 🎶🎭

LETRA:

Pero cada año llega la alegría,
pero cada año llega el sabor.
Sonando sonando del carnavalito 
Sonando sonando 
Junto al Guaracazo

Me fui a la Jhony a buscar trabajo, pero me deportan y ahora estoy aquí 
Me fui a la Jhony a buscar la vida pero me regresan y ahora estoy aquí ,
no fui mala nota no fui mala gente solo un migrante pero buena gente 
no importa la plata, no importa la deuda,
lo que ahora importa es mi familita.

La joya es fina  cuando es real,
la mujer es bella cuando es natural.//
De lejos te miro y te reconozco,
en tu caminada, en tus movimientos.

Las flores del campo florecen solitas,
así es mi guambra, florece solita.
La estrella del cielo se brilla solita,
así es mi negra, se brilla solita.
Solo te lo pido, sé siempre sencilla ,
así como eres, así me enamoras.
